images.caption: Water distribution on Earth
images.shows: A layered diagram of where Earth's water is: oceans and seas (salt water) at the top, a thin stream of fresh water below it, then ice caps and glaciers, ground water, surface water, lakes, rivers, soil moisture, water vapour in the atmosphere and living organisms. The percentages printed on the diagram are its own and differ slightly from the chapter text (97% salt, 3% fresh).

images.caption: Yangtze, China
images.shows: A wide green river winding through steep forested gorge walls, with small boats on the water: the Yangtze river in China.

images.caption: Ancient river valley civilisations
images.shows: A coloured world map marking where early civilisations and early farming began along river valleys, with a colour key listing the regions.

images.caption: Water scarcity prediction
images.shows: A world map shaded by projected water stress in 2040 by country, from low to extremely high, with a legend. The darkest areas are North Africa and the Middle East.

images.caption: Grey water recycling
images.shows: A flow diagram: water from the shower, laundry, hand washing and dish washing goes into a grey water recycler, and the recycled water goes to flushing toilets and watering the garden.

images.caption: Smart irrigation
images.shows: A farm field of green crop rows being watered by sprinklers, with fine sprays of water over the plants.

images.caption: Smart irrigation
images.shows: A phone screen of an irrigation app showing soil moisture 72%, temperature and a motor switch that is on.

images.caption: States of water
images.shows: A diagram of water as gas, liquid and solid, with arrows labelled vaporization, condensation, sublimation, deposition, freezing and melting between them: a glass of water, an ice block and a cloud.

images.caption: Surface tension as swimmer emerges
images.shows: A close view of a swimmer's head rising from the water, with a thin film of water stretched over the face and cap as it comes up.

images.caption: Water strider, using surface tension to walk
images.shows: A water strider insect standing on the surface of a pond, its long legs making small dimples in the water.

images.caption: Frost forming
images.shows: Feathery ice crystals of frost spreading across a cold surface.

images.caption: Warm water under the frozen surface of the sea allows life to exist
images.shows: Two seals swimming in bright blue water beneath the ice of a frozen sea.

images.caption: Cyclones
images.shows: A satellite view of two large swirling cyclones over the sea, each with a clear eye.

images.caption: Water vapour appear as mist in the forest
images.shows: Thick white mist hanging over a dark green pine forest on a hillside.

images.caption: Solar powered water heating system
images.shows: A rooftop solar water heater: a flat blue solar panel with a cylindrical hot-water tank above it, against a blue sky.

images.caption: Steam engine and its internal mechanism
images.shows: A cut-away diagram of a steam locomotive labelled steam, water, fire, crank, connecting rod, piston and cylinder.

images.caption: Steam engine
images.shows: A black steam locomotive with a red base and steam rising from it, standing in a wooded setting.

images.caption: Hydro jetting for a sugar mill
images.shows: A large industrial plant with tall steel tanks, pipes and yellow walkways against a blue sky (the book's caption: hydro jetting for a sugar mill).

images.caption: Shrinking Arctic ice-cap
images.shows: Two satellite views of the Arctic side by side, September 1984 and September 2016, the later one with much less white sea ice.

images.caption: Chhat Puja in a polluted, toxic Yamuna river
images.shows: Women in bright saris standing in knee-deep river water carrying offerings, with white toxic foam floating on the water around them.

images.caption: Adalaj stepwell
images.shows: The inside of a deep stepwell with carved stone galleries on several levels and still green water at the bottom.

images.caption: Rain water harvesting
images.shows: An illustrated diagram of rainwater harvesting: rain runs off a roof through a gutter and pipe, past a filter into a main tank with a pump and overflow to the groundwater well, with uses labelled: garden watering, car washing, toilet flushing and clothes washing.

images.caption: Floating city in Maldives
images.shows: An aerial view of a planned floating city in the sea near an island, laid out in a maze-like pattern of walkways and buildings.

images.caption: Solar panels designed in Oceanix, South Korea
images.shows: A concept view of floating hexagonal platforms with houses, green areas and solar panels on the sea.

images.caption: Indian stepwell
images.shows: A large stepwell seen from the side, with rows of zig-zag stone steps going down to green water, and a covered arcade above.

images.caption: Persian Qanat
images.shows: A narrow underground tunnel carved in earth with light coming down from a shaft above: a qanat that carries water underground.

images.caption: Freshwater aquatic animals
images.shows: A collage of four freshwater animals: an alligator with open jaws, a trout, an otter on a rock and a frog on a leaf.
A green glass frog with yellow spots sitting on a green leaf.
A crocodile resting on a sandy bank with its mouth open.
Three otters floating on their backs on the surface of the water.

images.caption: Saltwater aquatic animals
images.shows: A lionfish with long striped fins swimming in clear blue sea water.

images.caption: Saltwater aquatic animals
images.shows: A dark spotted eagle ray gliding over a rocky sea floor.

images.caption: Saltwater aquatic animals
images.shows: A hermit crab walking out of a spiral shell on a beach.

images.caption: Saltwater aquatic animals
images.shows: A humpback whale leaping out of the sea, its long fin raised.

images.caption: Saltwater aquatic animals
images.shows: A red octopus with suckers on its arms on a coral reef.

images.caption: Saltwater aquatic animals
images.shows: Many orange and white clownfish swimming among sea anemone tentacles.

images.caption: Phytoplanktons
images.shows: A colourful drawing of many tiny floating plankton of different shapes, round, spiky and feathery, in blue-green water.

images.caption: Algae under microscope
images.shows: Round green algae cells of different sizes seen under a microscope.

images.caption: Movement of energy through different levels of food chain
images.shows: An ocean food chain diagram: sunlight to phytoplankton (primary producers), then zooplankton (primary consumers), small fishes and mackerel (secondary consumers), then tuna and a great white shark (tertiary consumers), with arrows showing the direction of energy.

images.caption: Whales use blowhole to breathe
images.shows: A whale at the sea surface blowing a tall plume of spray from its blowhole.

images.caption: Gills filter oxygen from sea water
images.shows: The head of a pink-orange fish with its gill cover open, showing the red feathery gills inside.

images.caption: Water repelling aquatic leaves
images.shows: Green floating leaves covered in water drops, with an enlarged diagram showing air trapped between waxy hairs so the water sits on top.

images.caption: CO2 being trapped in oceans
images.shows: An infographic poster, Ecosystem Recovery: carbon dioxide going into the sea, phytoplankton at the top, whales, and a sinking whale body storing carbon on the sea floor.

images.caption: Water cleaning filter feeders
images.shows: Underwater sponges and sea fans growing on a reef, including orange sponges among tall tangled seaweed-like stalks.

images.caption: Chemicals dumping into water bodies
images.shows: A large dark pipe pouring muddy waste water out onto the edge of a lake or marsh.

images.caption: Overfishing
images.shows: Fishermen on a boat lifting a big net full of red fish above a deck piled with fish.
